title: The next-word machine: how a language model writes
description:
Build a sentence word by word, see the probabilities behind each choice, play with temperature and see how text becomes tokens. A teaching resource on the fundamentals of generative AI for non-specialists.

Teaching resource of the course Fundamentals of generative AI (Ciência e Letras).

Live tool: https://ciencia-letras.github.io/next-word-machine/

Code under the MIT licence; content under CC BY 4.0. Any institution may use, adapt and share it, as long as it cites the tool.

Illustrative probabilities, for teaching. Not the output of a real model.
